author: ildyria
body:
Closes #1095

Drops the album_id attribute from the 'photos` table and create a relation table to allow a photo to be related to multiple albums.

This pull request introduces significant changes to the handling of photo and album operations, focusing on improving database integrity, optimizing queries, and enhancing maintainability. Key updates include refactoring the `Delete` and `Merge` actions for albums, modifying the `PositionData` logic, and restructuring photo deletion to better handle relationships and constraints.

### Album and Photo Deletion Refactor:
* Removed logic for handling unsorted albums directly in `app/Actions/Album/Delete.php`. Simplified the deletion process by delegating photo and album relationship handling to the `PhotoDelete` class, which now accepts an optional `from_id` parameter for improved flexibility. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-7f930fae35b7991a670c42b5fd0ba57c4d1d594f52124d468eb9980dd4518146L76-L87) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-7f930fae35b7991a670c42b5fd0ba57c4d1d594f52124d468eb9980dd4518146L114-R100) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-e0c4b6ea7da25e3d3dc2950d2d409081dc505d4eac7dbee1904486c1f580909dR74-L85)
* Added validation and helper methods in `app/Actions/Photo/Delete.php` to ensure arguments are consistent and to collect photos based on their album relationships. This includes methods like `collectUnsortedPhotos`, `collectPhotosInAlbums`, and `collectPhotosInAlbumsByAlbumID`. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-e0c4b6ea7da25e3d3dc2950d2d409081dc505d4eac7dbee1904486c1f580909dL98-R192) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-e0c4b6ea7da25e3d3dc2950d2d409081dc505d4eac7dbee1904486c1f580909dL145-R211)
* Removed redundant logic for collecting size variants and live photo paths by album IDs, consolidating these operations to focus on photo IDs instead. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-e0c4b6ea7da25e3d3dc2950d2d409081dc505d4eac7dbee1904486c1f580909dL163-R225) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-e0c4b6ea7da25e3d3dc2950d2d409081dc505d4eac7dbee1904486c1f580909dL228-L276)

### Album Merging Enhancements:
* Updated the `Merge` action in `app/Actions/Album/Merge.php` to handle many-to-many relationships between photos and albums using the `PA::PHOTO_ALBUM` table. This avoids duplicate entries by deleting existing links before inserting new ones.

### Position Data Updates:
* Changed the `PositionData` logic in `app/Actions/Album/PositionData.php` and `app/Actions/Albums/PositionData.php` to use the `albums` relationship instead of `album`. This aligns with the shift to many-to-many relationships. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-233cfc4cf31a7891d3f0af90dfd0cf25f190c35a513d87c47b40ba2c843dd78bL28-R28) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-84e38b36fe0dc355f3e21db8dcf94db3f4f04771ab9bc454684ade4cb1ef4fc0L41-R42)
* Modified the `PositionDataResource` constructor calls to reflect these changes. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-233cfc4cf31a7891d3f0af90dfd0cf25f190c35a513d87c47b40ba2c843dd78bL49-R49) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-84e38b36fe0dc355f3e21db8dcf94db3f4f04771ab9bc454684ade4cb1ef4fc0L65-R66)

### Database Integrity and Diagnostics:
* Updated the `DBIntegrityCheck` pipe in `app/Actions/Diagnostics/Pipes/Checks/DBIntegrityCheck.php` to use the `albums` relationship when checking for photos without originals. This ensures compatibility with the new data model.

### Miscellaneous Improvements:
* Simplified photo creation pipelines in `app/Actions/Photo/Create.php` by splitting `SetParentAndOwnership` into `SetParent` and `SetOwnership`. This improves modularity and clarity. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-685f47499dc041e9e6adcdfc1f9dfc502beb845b0c509570dfeeb628acb0e123L142-R144) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-685f47499dc041e9e6adcdfc1f9dfc502beb845b0c509570dfeeb628acb0e123L170-R177) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-685f47499dc041e9e6adcdfc1f9dfc502beb845b0c509570dfeeb628acb0e123L260-R268)

body:
## Краткое описание от Sourcery

Интегрируйте новый LLM бэкенд на основе OpenRouter, добавив специальный класс ChatOpenRouter, переключите приложение на его использование в качестве модели по умолчанию и улучшите пользовательский интерфейс с помощью настраиваемого чат-интерфейса и элементов управления извлечением документов.

Новые возможности:
- Добавьте класс ChatOpenRouter для интеграции OpenRouter API
- Установите ChatOpenRouter в качестве LLM по умолчанию и обновите переключение моделей для его использования
- Внедрите состояние k_documents для управления количеством извлекаемых документов для запросов
- Интегрируйте компонент Gradio ChatInterface с поддержкой дополнительных входных данных и сохраненных разговоров

Улучшения:
- Замените ручную многомодальную компоновку текстового поля на Gradio ChatInterface для оптимизации потока чата
- Закомментируйте избыточный вызов обновления модели во время потоковой передачи ответа

<details>
<summary>Original summary in English</summary>

## Summary by Sourcery

Integrate a new OpenRouter-based LLM backend by adding a dedicated ChatOpenRouter class, switch the application to use it as the default model, and enhance the UI with a configurable chat interface and document retrieval controls.

New Features:
- Add ChatOpenRouter class for OpenRouter API integration
- Set ChatOpenRouter as the default LLM and update model switching to use it
- Introduce k_documents state to control the number of retrieved documents for queries
- Integrate Gradio ChatInterface component with support for additional inputs and saved conversations

Enhancements:
- Replace manual multimodal textbox layout with Gradio ChatInterface for streamlined chat flow
- Comment out redundant model update call during response streaming

</details>

author: miladrv
body:
## Closes #585 #1229 #1915 
- #585
- #1229
- #1598
- #1915 

## Proposed Changes
This PR implements global rate limiting per #1229.

- Introduced a new `RouteKeys` array into the global `RateLimitOptions` to consolidate global options into a single group.
- The `RateLimitOptionsCreator` class implements a merging algorithm that performs merging on a per-option basis.
- `DynamicsCreator` enables the merging of dynamic route `RateLimitOptions`, accomplished through models and their interfaces.
- Upgraded `File` models and introduced new ones to incorporate additional RL rules and potentially implement rate limiter algorithms.
- Refactored `RateLimitOptions` to serve as a unified business model, consolidating all configuration.
- Enhanced `ClientRequestIdentity` uniqueness by eliminating incorrect path and method data (as they don't ensure a unique key) and substituting them with the stable route `LoadBalancerKey`, which is inherently unique.
- Refactored the `RateLimiting` core service by separating fixed window algorithms and adding a new `DateTime now` parameter for precise calculations, effectively resolving previously unstable buggy behavior.
- Refactored the `RateLimitingMiddleware` workflow by introducing new `Break` and `Block` flows. The `Block` flow, in particular, enhances security by disallowing unknown clients; however, the ultimate security bottleneck remains unresolved.
- Improved code coverage through unit tests by a +1.3% margin, as noted in the latest [Coveralls report](https://github.com/ThreeMammals/Ocelot/pull/2294#issuecomment-2890349397).
- Updated all packages of `*.csproj`, including `Microsoft.*`, to the latest version 9.0.9.

## Goal
The goal of this optimization is to reduce the time between a user's fetch action or refresh and the moment results start to appear, especially with a large amount of files, in order to improve the user experience.

## Changes
- Implemented conversion of backend file data in batches.
  - Change fileStore.fileList to have type (ClientFile | undefined) and refactored his usages to handle undefined.
  - Compute the masonry layout immediately using backend data, without waiting to define all ClientFiles.
- Reworked and optimized the refresh feature.
- Created a ProgressBar component and use it to show fetch progress for better UX with large file lists.
- Fix RafaUC/Allusion#28 - Abort previous fetches when a new one starts.
 
## Testing
Tested time to present images during startup fetch, fetch all, and refresh, with over 16,600 images.
- Show all files on startup: 
  - Average time reduced from 7,958 ms to 5,930 ms.
- Show all files after switching from another content type:

- Refresh:

author: fearless16
body:
## 🌍 Overview

This PR implements the complete **Environment Management** feature for DRUT.  
Users can now create named environments containing key-value pairs and inject them dynamically into URLs and request bodies using `{{VAR}}` syntax.

---

## ✅ What's Included

### 🧠 Context Logic

- `EnvContext.tsx`: Global context to manage multiple named environments
  - `addEnv`, `updateEnv`, `deleteEnv`, `selectEnv`
  - Tracks `selectedEnvId`
  - Stores to and loads from **IndexedDB via localforage**

### 🔄 Resolver

- `envResolver.ts`: Replaces `{{VAR}}` syntax with values from selected env
- Used inside `RequestBuilder.tsx` before sending request

### 💾 Persistence

- All environments stored in IndexedDB (`localforage`)
- Selected environment is persisted between reloads

---

## 💻 UI Components

- `EnvPage.tsx`: Main page to manage environments
- `EnvList.tsx`: Lists all environments
- `EnvEditor.tsx`: Form to add/edit environments
- `EnvSelector.tsx`: Dropdown injected in request form for selecting active env

All components are built using **React Bootstrap** for consistent styling.

---

## 🧪 Testing

- ✅ `EnvContext.test.ts`: Full coverage of add/update/delete/select/load
- ✅ `EnvList.test.tsx`: Render, edit, delete
- ✅ `EnvEditor.test.tsx`: Full form logic, add/remove vars, submit, cancel
- ✅ `EnvSelector.test.tsx`: Select event fires
- ✅ `EnvPage.test.tsx`: Integration render
- ✅ `envResolver.test.ts`: Resolves multiple/missing variables

🎯 **100% code coverage** on all components and context logic.

---

## 💅 Code Style & Structure

- Follows Prettier config:
  - `"singleQuote": true`, `"semi": false`, `"trailingComma": "es5"`
- Strong typing on all components/hooks
- Folder structure respected (`components/Env`, `context/`, `lib/`)

---

## 🧭 Routing & Integration

- Page mounted at `/env`
- Added `EnvSelector` to `RequestBuilder` for runtime substitution

---

## 🧱 Folder Structure

```bash
src/
  context/EnvContext.tsx
  lib/envResolver.ts
  hooks/useEnv.ts

    EnvList.tsx
    EnvEditor.tsx

tests/

  lib/envResolver.test.ts
  components/EnvList.test.tsx
  components/EnvEditor.test.tsx
  components/EnvSelector.test.tsx

author: davidz25
body:
Change onFrameCaptured() so it doesn't return an ImageBitmap which was intended to be used for the application to overlay graphics. Instead, if users want to overlay graphics they can simply arrange their composition so a `Canvas` overlays the `Camera` composable.

Use platform-native types for the returned frame - on Android this is an ImageProxy and on iOS it's an UIImage. Note that the captured frame is different sizes/rotation/etc from the preview. To deal with this, pass a Matrix in CameraFrame so the application can properly transform into preview space.

Hook this up to barcode scanning and also in CameraScreen have use-cases that use the preview (drawing an animation on top) and don't use the previes (just showing an Image with the captured bitmap).

Test: Manually tested barcode scanning on both Android and iOS.

This PR adds more graphs to `graphs_lib`:
* All transpositions.
* [Pancake](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pancake_graph).
* Full reversals.
* 3x3x3 Rubik's Cube (quarter-turn and half-turn metrics). [Source](https://www.kaggle.com/code/ivankolt/generation-of-incidence-mtx-pancake).

Also:
* Changed type returned by `prepare_graph` so it returns `CayleyGraph` instead of pair (generators, initial state). If you only care about generators, you can do `prepare_graph(...).generators`.
* Supported passing generator names to CayleyGraph. Most functions in `prepare_graph` now specify inormative generator names.
* Rename "incidence matrix" to "adjacency matrix".
* Add precomputed growth functions for all_transpositions, pancake, full_reversals.

Updated [demo notebook](https://www.kaggle.com/code/fedimser/cayleypy-demo).

author: deadsec69
body: This pull request addresses the high CPU usage issue in the 'test-app:8001' pod by reducing the graph size in the CPU-intensive task from 20 to 10 nodes. This change is expected to decrease the CPU load and prevent the pod from being restarted due to high CPU usage. The modification is made in the 'cpu_intensive_task' function, where the graph size is set to 10 nodes, thereby reducing the computational complexity of the brute force shortest path algorithm.

author: roosto
body:
From the `--help` output:

> Usage: ride-faker.js [--help] --beacon-hash beacon_hash --routekey routeKeyStr [--tick-interval miliseconds] routeFile
> 
> A development utility to post coordinates to a route's beacon page, which
> will simulate a bike bus moving along the route.
> 
>  Options:
>     --beacon-hash|-b    Required. The `beacon_hash` value to use when
>                         POSTing. If not supplied, will use the Environment
>                         variable `beacon_hash`, if it exists and is set
>     --help|-h           show this text and exit
>     --routekey|-k       Required. The routeKey to be used when POSTing
>                         locations to the API
>     --tick-interval|-t  Time, in miliseconds, to wait between POSTing the
>                         next coordinates along the route. Default: 15000
> 
>  routeFile:
>     path to a route file, though the file need not neccessarily be a route
>     route file. The only thing that the JSON file needs to have is an array
>     with a key named `stop` underneath a key that matches the values supplied
>     to --routekey

It's pretty straight forward, I think. Also it's just a dev tool, so it doesn't have to be great.

The one part about it that is a little funky is that if "stops" are > 100m apart the script will create several in between coordinates to move to, so that the coordinates don't jump a huge amount at one time. Which I feel clever about.

Я створила partials modal.html та modal.css, підключила їх в головних файлах index.html та styles.css. Аналогічно з modal.js, який ти раніше вже підключила в main.js (в main.js випадково було двічі підключено modal.js, мабуть перший то одруківка і має бути menu.js). 
Розмітку я зробила одним файлом (спочатку думала три окремих для трьох модалок, але вчасно зрозуміла, що то зайве). Стилі спільні для трьох видів модалок. 
В modal.js я тричі вставила код, змінивши ім`я змінних (додала -s, -m, -l відповідно). Потрібні змінні розставила по html розмітці + те, що мав додати Віталій. Якщо не працює через js, можна побачити модалки, додавши до них клас is-open в інспекторі. Стосовно двох кнопок в третій картці Віталія, довелось ще змінити скрипт, в цьому питанні вже отримала допомогу ззовні)))). Але тепер все працює.

Також в reset.css у нас поки немає скидання line-height по input та button, а у H1 font-weight, тому ці властивості я прописала у відповідних класах в modal.css
